subject.title: [Workspace panel] Root path drops leading dot, false 'Missing' labels on existing folders, broken layout

question: Should Session Workspace listings hide or neutralize transcript-mentioned paths outside the fs-safe workspace boundary, or intentionally expose their existence metadata?
rationale: The remaining false Missing behavior sits on a file-metadata boundary, and automation cannot choose between hiding external paths, adding a neutral external state, or exposing external existence/mtime/size without maintainer intent.

options.title: Keep Metadata Inside Fs-Safe
options.body: External or fs-safe-rejected paths remain hidden or neutral, and only workspace-contained files/folders get normal present/missing semantics.

options.title: Expose External Metadata Deliberately
options.body: The Gateway may return existence metadata for transcript-mentioned external paths, but that needs explicit tests and security-boundary documentation before merge.

options.title: Split Layout From Backend Semantics
options.body: Carry only any still-needed CSS repair separately while the backend listing semantics are decided under the linked PR or a replacement.

recommendation.title: Keep Metadata Inside Fs-Safe
recommendation.body: External or fs-safe-rejected paths remain hidden or neutral, and only workspace-contained files/folders get normal present/missing semantics.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent workspace file preview work makes this the strongest routing owner for the fs-safe session-file boundary decision.
